guide.the_skill_teaches_delegation_norma: The Skill teaches delegation, Norma CLI routes work, Agent Hook reports lifecycle events, and authorization keeps access scoped to this device.
guide.voice_group_control_direct_six_age: Voice group control: direct six Agents at once
guide.agents_delegate_tasks_to_each_othe: Agents delegate tasks to each other
guide.know_when_an_agent_needs_you: Know When an Agent Needs You
guide.install_orchestration_for_the_agen: Install orchestration for the agents you use. Norma configures the Skill, CLI, Agent Hook, and authorization together.
guide.one_spoken_instruction_controls_si: One spoken instruction controls six Agents. Norma creates six Agent Live Nodes, gives each one its own task, and keeps every run visible in the same workspace.
guide.one_agent_can_hand_a_focused_task_: One Agent can hand a focused task to another Agent and receive the result inside the same workspace. Work branches without making you relay every instruction yourself.
guide.press_1_6_to_bring_a_specific_live: Press ⌘1–6 to bring a specific Live Node forward instantly. Move between agents, terminals, and previews without hunting through tabs.
guide.press_m_to_switch_between_focused_: Press ⌘M to switch between focused and overview layouts. Every running Live Node stays visible, active, and connected to its task.
guide.completion_and_attention_indicator: Completion and attention indicators appear directly on the relevant Live Node, so you can see which agent changed state without checking every terminal.
